questions.question: What does CSS stand for?
questions.explanation: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of CSS?
options: To control the appearance and layout of web pages
questions.explanation: CSS controls presentation, styling and layout.

questions.question: Which selector targets all paragraph elements?
questions.explanation: p is an element selector targeting paragraph elements.

questions.question: Which symbol starts a class selector?
questions.explanation: A class selector begins with a dot.

questions.question: Which symbol starts an ID selector?
questions.explanation: An ID selector begins with #.

questions.question: Which CSS property changes text color?
questions.explanation: The color property changes text color.

questions.question: Which property changes the size of text?
questions.explanation: font-size controls text size.

questions.question: Which is NOT part of the CSS box model?
questions.explanation: The box model consists of content, padding, border and margin.

questions.question: What does padding create?
questions.explanation: Padding is the space between content and the border.

questions.question: What does margin create?
questions.explanation: Margin creates space outside the border.

questions.question: Which property controls how an element participates in layout?
questions.explanation: The display property controls an element's layout behavior.

questions.question: Which property controls an element's positioning method?
questions.explanation: The position property controls positioning behavior.

questions.question: Which value creates a flex container?
questions.explanation: display: flex creates a flex container.

questions.question: What does justify-content control in Flexbox?
questions.explanation: justify-content controls distribution along the main axis.

questions.question: What does align-items control in Flexbox?
questions.explanation: align-items controls alignment along the cross axis.

questions.question: Which CSS layout system is designed for rows and columns?
questions.explanation: CSS Grid provides a two-dimensional row and column layout system.

questions.question: Which property defines grid columns?
questions.explanation: grid-template-columns defines grid column tracks.

questions.question: What is responsive design?
options: Design that adapts to different screen sizes
Design that uses only desktop screens
questions.explanation: Responsive design adapts layouts to different devices and screen sizes.

questions.question: Which feature is commonly used to apply CSS based on screen width?
questions.explanation: CSS media queries allow conditional styling based on viewport characteristics.

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes HTML and CSS?
options: HTML provides structure and CSS provides presentation
CSS provides databases and HTML provides servers
questions.explanation: HTML structures content while CSS controls presentation and layout.
